welcome_body: Make room for the things that matter. Bring everyone’s plans, everyday jobs and little reminders together.
plan_body: A colour for everyone. A calendar for the whole household.
tasks_body: From school bags to shopping bags, give every little job a home.
offline_body: Your plans stay on this tablet. No account, advertising or internet connection needed.
pin_help: Keep this PIN safe. It protects adult actions on this shared tablet. There is no remote PIN recovery.
setup_body: Start with one adult. Add the rest of your household in Family.
calendar_consent: Allow read-only access to your device calendar, then choose events to copy. Imported events are private to adults until you change their visibility. If connected mode is enabled, selected events will also be sent to your household server.
calendar_empty: No device calendar events were found in the next 90 days, or this device has no calendar provider. You can always add plans manually.
local_only: Saved on this tablet · Offline ready
priority_hint: What would make today a good day?
keep_awake: Keep display awake while the kitchen board is open
locked_body: Adults use the parent PIN. Children can open their own space.
adult_gate_body: Enter the parent PIN to continue. Adult access locks after five minutes or when you leave the app.
pin_error: That PIN didn’t match, or access is temporarily locked. After five incorrect attempts, wait at least a minute.
title: Title
child_visible: Visible in child spaces and kitchen board
private_reminder: Something is coming up. Open your family board to see it.
empty_events: A little breathing room. No plans here yet.
empty_chores: All clear here. Add a little job to get started.
empty_notes: A home for the little things you want everyone to know.
empty_lists: From groceries to school supplies, make your first list.
empty_items: What do we need? Add your first item.
overlap_body: Someone already has a plan at this time: %1$s. You can still save both plans.
delete_body: This removes the whole recurring series, if it repeats. Use Skip this date to remove one occurrence.
family_help: Up to six people in this development edition. Children never need an email address. All adult roles use the shared parent PIN.
remove_member_body: Remove %1$s? Their plans will remain, with their assignment removed.
notification_help: Reminders are private and approximate. Fire OS battery settings may delay them. Keep the app allowed to run in the background.
privacy_body: Household data stays in this app’s private storage unless an adult enables connected mode. No analytics or advertising. Connected mode sends household data to the server you choose. Voice uses your device’s optional recognition service; it may process speech online. Backups and shared lists leave the app only when you choose to share them.
backup_warning: Backups contain household information as readable JSON. Choose a private location. Restoring replaces this tablet’s household data and retains the current parent PIN.
erase_body: This permanently removes all plans, lists, chores, members and the parent PIN from this tablet. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
development_body: Local household tools are available without a subscription in this build. Connected mode requires your own configured HTTPS server. Amazon purchases are not enabled. No payment or free trial is offered.
sync_consent: Connect only to a server you trust. Your household’s plans, messages, lists and member names will be sent there. PINs stay on this tablet. Each authorised device uses its own local parent PIN.
resolve_body: This tablet and another device changed the household. Export a backup before choosing. Keep this tablet sends its full household to the server. Use server replaces this tablet’s plans and members with the server version. These choices apply to the whole household.
invite_help: Share this code privately with a trusted adult. It can be used once to authorise a device with access to your household.
delete_remote_body: This deletes the server copy and revokes every connected device. Local copies remain on other tablets until their adults delete them. Disconnecting alone does not delete the server copy.
voice_title: Say a little. Plan a little.
voice_body: Try “Add milk to the shopping list”, or dictate a note. Your device’s speech service may use the internet. Review the words before saving.
voice_unavailable: Voice recognition is unavailable on this device. Type your words below.
tts_unavailable: Text-to-speech is unavailable for this language.
voice_child_help: You can read the plans and jobs shared with your space.
error_body: The change could not be saved. Check your details, unlock adult access if needed, and try again. Your existing data is safe.
conflict_error: This record changed since you opened it. Close the editor and open it again before saving.
invalid_details: Please check the title, dates, time zone and numeric fields.
child_intro: Your plans. Your jobs. A little helping hand.
language_help: Dates and numbers follow the tablet language. English interface; other languages are pending human review.
no_child: Add a child profile in Family to create a child space.
